name: Textream v1.7.0
body:
## Installation

- **Textream.dmg** — for macOS 26 Tahoe and later (recommended, includes Liquid Glass effects)
- **Textream-macos15.dmg** — for macOS 15 Sequoia

1. Download the DMG for your macOS version.
2. Open the DMG and drag **Textream** to Applications.
3. Open Textream normally. The app is signed and notarized by Apple.

Or install via Homebrew:

```sh
brew install textream
```

## Highlights

- A new **Reading** settings pane brings together reading position, paragraph dividers, last-spoken words, and keep-awake controls.
- Choose **Centered** or **Near Top** reading position with steadier tracking, correct live-preview geometry, and animated preview transitions.
- Optional paragraph breaks now appear as subtle three-dot dividers with more breathing room.
- Remote viewers can mirror the teleprompter independently per device, including URL presets with `?mirror=1` and `?mirror=0`.
- Start the prompter directly from the editor with **Command–Return**.
- Director Mode now preserves paragraph breaks during live edits and protects the confirmed read prefix more reliably.
- The compact notch has improved spacing around its controls and a softer text fade near the bottom.
- A complete guide at [textream.net/docs](https://textream.net/docs/) documents every setting, script cues, the URL scheme, and Director API examples in Swift, JavaScript, Python, and Node.js.
- The source tree now includes Textream for iPhone and iPad, with Word Tracking, Classic and Voice-Activated guidance, camera recording, saved recordings, and landscape mirror controls. Mobile distribution is handled separately through the App Store.

## Fixes and polish

- Fixed Near Top positioning in Classic and Voice-Activated settings previews.
- Fixed paragraph preservation in the Director browser editor.
- Fixed **Reset All** so it also restores speech language and Hide from Screen Sharing.
- Restricted Remote and Director custom ports to `1024–65534`, preserving the required WebSocket port.
- Improved live layout recalculation after font and overlay-size changes.
- Made PowerPoint presenter-note imports reliable in the Mac App Store sandbox.

## Merged pull requests

- [#79 — docs: use official Homebrew install command](https://github.com/f/textream/pull/79) by @f
- [#80 — Prepare Textream for the Mac App Store](https://github.com/f/textream/pull/80) by @f
- [#81 — Make PowerPoint import reliable in the App Store sandbox](https://github.com/f/textream/pull/81) by @f
- [#82 — Declare App Store export compliance](https://github.com/f/textream/pull/82) by @f
- [#83 — Add direct support email](https://github.com/f/textream/pull/83) by @f
- [#84 — docs: remove signed and notarized note](https://github.com/f/textream/pull/84) by @f
- [#85 — Configure textream.net as the canonical domain](https://github.com/f/textream/pull/85) by @f
- [#86 — Add App Store download to homepage](https://github.com/f/textream/pull/86) by @f
- [#87 — Add Mac App Store link to README](https://github.com/f/textream/pull/87) by @f
- [#96 — Add configurable teleprompter reading options](https://github.com/f/textream/pull/96) by @needim
- [#97 — Add per-device mirror mode to the Remote teleprompter view](https://github.com/f/textream/pull/97) by @skobylite
- [#100 — Start the prompter with ⌘↩ from the main window](https://github.com/f/textream/pull/100) by @skobylite
- [#101 — Add Reading settings and comprehensive documentation](https://github.com/f/textream/pull/101) by @f

## Contributors

Thank you to @needim for the new reading controls and tracking improvements, and to @skobylite for per-device Remote mirroring and the Command–Return shortcut. Thanks also to @voicaandrei for the earlier mirror-mode proposal referenced by #97.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/f/textream/compare/v1.6.5...v1.7.0

name: Textream v1.6.0
body:
## What's New

### Local language suggestions
- Detects the current script language entirely on-device with macOS Natural Language after 2.5 seconds without edits.
- Suggests a compatible speech-recognition locale when the script and selected speech language differ.
- Keeps language changes user-controlled and handles regional and Simplified/Traditional script variants.

### More reliable microphones and dictation
- Prevents stale permission and recognition callbacks from reviving or replacing stopped microphone sessions.
- Adds cancellable startup states, clearer microphone errors, retry backoff, and safer hardware-change recovery.
- Improves editor dictation across recognition restarts and multi-channel input devices.
- Prevents duplicate microphone sessions during page changes.

### Better word following
- Improves CJK token matching, bracketed cue handling, and completion around trailing punctuation.
- Uses long-form dictation hints and source context for better recognition accuracy.
- Includes the recognition-resilience improvements from PR #67 for jumps and transient recognizer availability.

## Installation

- **Textream.dmg** — macOS 26 Tahoe and later
- **Textream-macos15.dmg** — macOS 15 Sequoia

Download the DMG for your macOS version, open it, and drag **Textream** to Applications.

Since the app is not notarized, macOS may block it on first launch. Run:

```bash
xattr -cr /Applications/Textream.app
```

Or install with Homebrew:

```bash
brew install f/textream/textream
```

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/f/textream/compare/v1.5.2...v1.6.0

name: Textream v1.5.2
body:
## Changelog

### Features
- Add cue color and brightness settings for annotation text
- Add overlay transparency with blur and slider

### Bug Fixes
- Fix voice tracking highlight and mic stall bugs in word tracking mode
- Start playback from selected page and install key monitor in pinned mode
- Downmix multi-channel audio to mono for SFSpeechRecognizer
- Keep text visible after WPM auto-scroll reaches the end
- Stop BrowserServer timer from advancing after scroll completes
- Apply same fix to ExternalDisplayView and BrowserServer
- Always show page sidebar and read current page on play
